Home.headline: Full-stack/AI Engineer & Content Creator
Home.title: Hi,
Home.bio: I help businesses turn ideas into real, working products. I build <hl>full-stack applications</hl> and practical AI solutions — not just chatbots, but AI that can work with business data, automate workflows, and solve real problems. I <hl>care about the details</hl> that make a product feel solid.

howIWork.title: How I Work
howIWork.intro: Great projects start with clear communication and a strong connection throughout the process.

steps.label: 01. DISCOVER
steps.description: Clarify the business goals, user needs, constraints, and success criteria before deciding what to build.

steps.label: 02. DESIGN
steps.description: Define the architecture, data model, APIs, infrastructure, and AI approach — balancing simplicity, performance, and maintainability.

steps.label: 03. BUILD
steps.description: Implement the solution, test it thoroughly, and ensure it meets quality standards before deployment.

steps.label: 04. DELIVER
steps.description: Deploy to production, monitor real-world behavior, and iterate based on performance, feedback, and measurable results.
